Team — draft technical statement below; attaching isolation_diagram_vaultify.png. Please review and flag anything I missed. I kept it brief for procurement/security.

--- Technical statement (Draft) ---
1) Isolation model: Redwood will provision two dedicated reserved pools for Vaultify. Each pool will be backed by physically provisioned GPU nodes that are dedicated to Vaultify's tenancy (no other Redwood customers will be scheduled on these nodes). We will tag, taint, and isolate the entire node sets at the orchestration layer so scheduling is restricted to Vaultify workloads only. This meets the requirement for physical isolation without requiring separate datacenter cages.

2) Network and tenancy controls: Pools will be deployed in Vaultify's preferred region and attached to your VPC peering (or Private deployment equivalent). Network ACLs and private IP spaces will be configured so that control-plane access is limited to Vaultify admins and Redwood's SRE/ops.

3) KMS & encryption: Customer-managed KMS may be configured for model artifact encryption and KV caches. Key-rotation follows Redwood's standard rotation policy but can be aligned to customer key-retention policies if Vaultify supplies a BYOK key.

4) Audit logs & retention: All inference request metadata (request id, model version, user id if provided, timestamp, token counts, and routing decisions) will be logged and retained in audit logs for 18 months by default for Dedicated customers. Logs can be forwarded to Vaultify's SIEM (via secure syslog or S3 export) on a near-real-time basis. SOC 2 evidence export available on request.

5) Throughput & SLOs: For the additional +8 A100 GPUs, we commit to sustained throughput of 95k tokens/min with burst capability to 140k tokens/min under normal operating conditions. We will add a 30-day performance verification window post-provisioning.

6) Rollout plan & billing start: Proposed rollout —
   - 2027-01-20: kickoff with Vaultify infra + procurement (30m)
   - 2027-01-24: provisioning of reserved pool nodes (non-production smoke tests)
   - 2027-01-28: production cutover to new pool for limited traffic (canary)
   - 2027-02-01: full routing to reserved pools; billing start date

7) Fallback/backfill: Redwood will maintain a fallback routing policy that can spill to the emergency reserved pool or a compatible lower-cost model variant if needed.

Attachments: isolation_diagram_vaultify.png (architecture diagram).

If this looks good I'll convert to a short PDF statement for procurement and include specific contractual language for "exclusive tenant capacity" for legal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
